question: National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Programme, introduced in the Union Budget 2023, aims to eliminate sickle cell genetic transmission by the year ____________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**2047**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Programme** was introduced in the **Union Budget 2023** by the Government of India.
 
• The programme aims to **eliminate sickle cell genetic transmission** by the year **2047**, coinciding with the centenary of India's independence.
 
• **Sickle cell anaemia** is a genetic condition caused by a mutation in the haemoglobin gene, leading to the production of abnormal red blood cells.
 
• This condition is prevalent among the tribal population</strong&
